newsitem.title: CHINA: Tian An China in HK$183 mln shr placement.
newsitem.headline: Tian An China in HK$183 mln shr placement.

text.p: Tian An China Investments Co Ltd said on Monday it would place 170 million new shares, or 8.81 percent of its enlarged share capital, to third party investor Fujian Enterprises (Holdings) Co Ltd at HK$1.08 each.
Tian An China said the net proceed of about HK$183 million proceeds from the placement would be used to fund its property development and investment.
On completion of the deal on August 4, the shareholding of its controlling shareholder Sun Hung Kai & Co Ltd will be diluted to 35.84 percent from 39.30 percent.
Trading in Tian An China shares is due to resume on Monday after a one-day suspension on Friday. Its shares ended at HK$1.15 each on Thursday.

Fujian Enterprises, a company wholly-owned and supported by Fujian provincial government, is engaging in shipping, financing, investment, telecommunications, trading, tourism, manufacturing and property development and investment.
